lines.3: 「What's up, kid? Something on your mind?」
lines.5: 「I was just thinking I've been running into Konoe a lot lately.」
lines.7: 「As you know, I don't get along with her.」
lines.8: 「We had a huge fight, after all.」
lines.9: 「She's the one who started your whole tension theory, right?」
lines.10: 「I think Leo's tension theory is pretty questionable too.」
lines.11: 「But Konoe's got her own problems. She nags way too much.」
lines.12: 「I've never been in her class, so I don't know the details. But apparently some of the girls really can't stand her.」
lines.13: 「People with strong opinions tend to get that reaction.」
lines.15: 「But she's almost too put-together. Talking to her sounds boring.」
lines.16: 「Otome's strict about rules too, but she's got that cheerful sports-club energy, so she's actually pretty easy to talk to.」
lines.18: 「I've said it before, but guys sure are picky about women for people with such ugly mugs themselves.」
lines.19: 「Women do the same thing. They say personality matters, then plenty of them choose guys by the face.」
lines.21: 「I think she's a good woman. In English: good girl.」
lines.23: 「Don't do it, Chicken Leo. You'll just fight again and that'll be the end of it.」
lines.24: 「Me, who doesn't get swept up by the mood, and Konoe, who does... Yes, we're fundamentally incompatible.」
lines.25: 「No, you get swept along in the end too. You're a perfect match.」
lines.26: 「Perfect match or not, she spectacularly hates me.」
lines.27: 「Love and hate are two sides of the same coin.」
lines.28: 「Is that like mantis shrimp and shrimp looking alike but tasting different?」
lines.30: 「Who are you calling an idiot!? Someday I'm gonna make it big in games and start my own company! Kanisawa Bubble Land!!」
lines.31: 「That name sounds like it's gonna burst immediately.」
lines.32: 「And why would a game company have 'Land' in the name?」
lines.33: 「What, you wanna be president more than a game creator?」
lines.34: 「Creator comes first, obviously. But I want money too.」
lines.35: 「If I'm president, I get to keep all the profits! I'll buy out every pack of convenience-store sushi!」
lines.37: 「Yeah. I think I'm about to cry.」
lines.38: 「Keep all the profits as president? Want me to teach you about reality?」
lines.40: 「There's this thing called corporate tax. The government takes about thirty percent of a company's profits.」
lines.42: 「Put simply, if you make a hundred million yen, thirty million goes to the government.」
lines.44: 「Let's see, what else was there? Corporate resident tax, enterprise tax, income tax, and under certain conditions they hit you with consumption tax too...」
lines.45: 「I'm not lying. A woman who runs a company and I met through a part-time job was complaining about it.」
lines.46: 「Huh? Then why is this country buried in debt?」
lines.47: 「Because our politicians are extremely competent, obviously.」
lines.48: ...What were we talking about at the beginning?
lines.49: Somehow we'd ended up having a serious social-policy debate.
